author: Bee (Shel)
title: Paid character/concept art for adult fantasy series
content: ARTISTS + ANIMATORS OF THREADS! I’m a writer developing an adult fantasy animated series and I’m looking for artists to help bring it to life! I’m starting small, but this is paid work. I’m looking to commission character/concept art first and grow from there. Fantasy artists/animators—drop your work + rates!! Contact: reply on the post with work and rates. Follow-up from author (2026-09-13): still early, figuring out funding and budgeting, not closed.

author: blekek.k
title: Illustrators wanted for trading card project
content: Hi warga threads! We're looking for illustrators for our little trading card project. Whether you draw professionally, as a hobby, are still a student, or already work full-time, feel free to reach out. We're looking for artists that draws: Anime / manga style illustrations; Cartoon / semi-cartoon illustration; Pokemon / One Piece / MTG TCG artwork; Semi-realistic illustrations; and any other art styles. Comment if you're interested or DM me directly!
